gap_matrix.label: Covered by Dedicated Desktop Rule (Needs Inline Safety FAQ Drawer)
gap_matrix.description: Scanned by a dedicated rule in app/src-tauri/src/rules.rs, but Cleaner.svelte does not yet show our web guide's 'What happens if I delete this?' safety explanation or empirical median GB badge.

gap_matrix.label: Bundled Inside Mega-Bucket Rule (Hidden Sub-App Breakdown in UI)
gap_matrix.description: Scanned on disk inside broad rules (game_launchers, dev_caches, gpu_shaders, adobe_caches), preventing users from seeing per-app GB savings (e.g., Steam vs Riot vs Genshin) or toggling individual toolchains.

gap_matrix.label: Missing Desktop Scanner Rule / Read-Only Storage Advisor Opportunity
gap_matrix.description: High-demand Windows/macOS bloat paths in clean-items.json (Ollama/LM Studio/HuggingFace model weights, Docker/WSL2 ext4.vhdx virtual disks, WinSxS, hiberfil.sys, DaVinci Resolve CacheClip) not yet surfaced in rules.rs.

gap_matrix.label: Mobile App & Cross-Device Linked-PC Companion Opportunity
gap_matrix.description: High-intent mobile/social media cache guides and cross-device flows where Android (DashboardScreen.kt) and iOS (DashboardView.swift) can surface an App Cache Encyclopedia Card and a 1-Click Linked PC Clean Trigger.

proposals.title: Inline 'Why Is This Safe to Delete?' Evidence Drawer & Empirical GB Badge
proposals.subtitle: Embed clean-items.json safety explanations, customFAQs, and A1 k-anonymous median GB badges directly into Cleaner.svelte category cards
proposals.gsc_evidence_summary: Top GSC queries ('is softwaredistribution download safe to delete', 'will clearing discord cache delete messages', 'windows prefetch safe to delete') prove safety anxiety is the #1 barrier before clicking Clean Now.
proposals.why_recommend: We have 377+ researched safety guides in clean-items.json with plain-English 'whatIsIt', 'whatHappens', and FAQ answers, yet Cleaner.svelte only displays a 1-line description. Adding an expandable '? Safe to Delete' pill on every category row eliminates user hesitation at the exact moment of the Free-to-Pro paywall trigger.
proposals.user_value_proposition: Instant plain-English proof that chat history, game saves, login sessions, and licenses remain 100% untouched—backed by SWEEPR's 7-day Quarantine restore guarantee.
proposals.monetization_hook: Increases scan-to-clean completion rate and Pro paywall conversion by resolving trust friction inside the app without sending users back to Google.

proposals.gsc_evidence_summary: huggingface-hub-cache, davinci-resolve-cacheclip, and davinci-resolve-optimized-media are active GSC strike-zone pages with 10 GB – 120 GB per-user bloat—the highest GB-per-scan cluster in our entire catalog.
proposals.why_recommend: Inspection of app/src-tauri/src/rules.rs (line 264) revealed that `creator_ai_caches` currently only scans `@home/.cache/huggingface/hub/.locks` (which is a few KB of lockfiles!) instead of orphaned model snapshots, Ollama blobs, LM Studio downloads, or DaVinci Resolve `CacheClip` render caches. Surfacing these multi-gigabyte caches immediately creates a 20 GB+ 'Aha Moment' scan result.
proposals.user_value_proposition: Finds forgotten 8 GB–80 GB local LLM model weights, interrupted HuggingFace/LM Studio downloads, and 4K video render caches that standard PC cleaners completely miss.
proposals.monetization_hook: Automatically triggers the A14 5GB+ Aha Milestone and positions SWEEPR Pro as the only cleaner built for modern AI/Creator workstations.

proposals.title: Read-Only System & Virtual Disk Compaction Advisor (WinSxS, Docker/WSL2 ext4.vhdx, hiberfil.sys)
proposals.subtitle: Add a non-destructive 'Deep System Storage Advisor' card in Cleaner.svelte for GSC's highest-impression Windows folders that cannot be blindly unlinked
proposals.gsc_evidence_summary: /clean/folder/winsxs, /clean/app/docker-desktop-ext4-disk, and /clean/folder/hiberfil-sys are top GSC impression winners in our organic portfolio.
proposals.why_recommend: Users land on sweeprcleaner.com searching how to shrink `WinSxS`, `docker_data.vhdx`, and `hiberfil.sys`. Because raw file deletion would break Windows or Docker, `rules.rs` currently ignores them completely—meaning a user who downloads SWEEPR from `/clean/folder/winsxs` doesn't see WinSxS in the app! A read-only Diagnostic Advisor Card that measures their exact GB size on disk and offers safe 1-click native Windows commands (`DISM /StartComponentCleanup`, `wsl --shutdown` + VHDX compact, `powercfg /h off`) bridges our #1 SEO funnel directly into the desktop app.
proposals.user_value_proposition: Safely measures hidden Windows system reserves (`WinSxS`, `hiberfil.sys`, `Windows.old`, and bloated Docker/WSL2 virtual disks) without risking OS corruption.
proposals.monetization_hook: Aligns the desktop scanner 1:1 with our highest-volume organic landing pages, boosting download-to-paid conversion on system folder queries.

proposals.title: Expandable Per-Game Launcher & Shader Breakdown (Steam, Genshin, Riot/Valorant, NVIDIA DXCache)
proposals.subtitle: Unbundle the monolithic game_launchers and gpu_shaders rules into toggleable per-launcher sub-rows inside Cleaner.svelte
proposals.gsc_evidence_summary: steam-shader-cache, genshin-impact-update-cache, nvidia-dxcache, ea-app-cache, and vrchat-cache all have verified GSC impressions and active strike-zone momentum.
proposals.why_recommend: `rules.rs` currently bundles 13 launchers into a single `game_launchers` category. Gamers want granular control: they want to wipe `VRChat` or `EA App` or `Steam depotcache` while keeping shader caches for the competitive FPS they play tonight. Adding expandable sub-rows per launcher in `Cleaner.svelte` (plus adding HoYoPlay/Genshin & VRChat paths) makes SWEEPR feel tailor-made for PC gamers.
proposals.user_value_proposition: See exact gigabytes used by Steam, Epic, Riot/Valorant, EA App, Battle.net, Genshin Impact, and VRChat individually—and uncheck any game you don't want touched.
proposals.monetization_hook: Drives high-retention weekly scans among gamers after every Patch Tuesday or season update (`A4` Bloat Watch loop).
